request.lower_description: Quiet muted forest-green short meadow grass for a fantasy tower defense board. Tiny restrained grass pixel clusters, low contrast and readable flat ground, no flowers or objects.
request.upper_description: Worn grey stone paving of small irregular flat stones with muted moss in the thin seams. Calm low-contrast surface for a walkable fantasy game path, no walls, no cliffs, no raised bank.
request.transition_description: Flat flush transition from meadow grass to worn stone paving, scattered moss at the edges. Both surfaces at the same ground level. Simple readable natural border.
